revision_reason: User requested an August baseline after reviewing September-baseline early-season results. This is an exploratory sensitivity analysis; post-pandemic outcomes have already informed the choice to examine this variant.
baseline_rule: Arithmetic mean of each shifted latent curve during weeks32-35; same definition in calibration and evaluation.
fixed_week_policy: Retain the previously trained week47 comparator, as requested. Report the optimum under the refitted training model separately without changing this comparator after evaluation.
threshold_rule: Median activity at each training pair optimum divided by its August baseline, with median ratio across exact tied optima; round to nearest0.1. Freeze before any new evaluation draw extraction.
non_crossing_policy: No trigger, zero modeled vaccine benefit, timing missing; retain in pooled benefit denominator.
pairing: Reuse prior season assignment, timing shifts, and pre-pandemic VE parameter pairs by draw ID; refit epidemic posteriors with August included. First50 IDs displayed without selection.
scope: Retrospective full-season latent-curve sensitivity analysis, not an as-of-data backtest, untouched temporal holdout, geographic holdout, or clinical recommendation. Manuscript checkpoints remain unchanged.
baseline_missingness_policy: Preserve missing observations with zero likelihood weights, as in the original GAM. Estimate latent August values through the same global plus season-specific smooth. Report missing-baseline cells; do not drop states or seasons based on outcomes.
